title: Compact support along one compactification on the localizing category
statement: Work in the standing scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of positive characteristic different from $\ell$, and let $X,Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$. Let $\Lambda$ be an admissible coefficient in the sense of [sk-def-localizing-closure]: a finite commutative ring annihilated by a power of $\ell$, or one of $\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, where $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite inside a fixed algebraic closure and $\mathcal O_E$ is its valuation ring, with the discrete topology in the finite case and the $\ell$-adic topology otherwise. Let $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism with $Y$ qcqs, and $f=p\circ j$ a compactification, $j:X\to\overline X$ a quasi-compact open immersion and $p:\overline X\to Y$ proper. Then $Rp_*\circ j_!:D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$ restricts to an exact functor $\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))\to\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\Lambda))$ which preserves direct sums and carries $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ into $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: *Extension by zero.* For the quasi-compact open immersion $j:X\to\overline X$, the existing extension-by-zero result states that $j_!$ maps $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ into $\Dctf(\overline X,\Lambda)$, preserves direct sums, and restricts to an exact, sum-preserving functor $\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))\to\Loc(\Dctf(\overline X,\Lambda))$.

source.place: First paragraph, Extension by zero; preservation supplied by the existing det-proper-image-localizing-open statement.

proof.text: *Proper direct image.* Apply [det-proper-image-localizing-proper] to $p:\overline X\to Y$. Its concluding coefficient clauses assert both of its hypotheses: preservation of $\Dctf$ and preservation of direct sums on $\Loc(\Dctf)$. For finite $\Lambda=A$ use its finite clause; for $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb$ use its corresponding clause. The stages $\mathbf Z_\ell$ and $\mathbf Q_\ell$, if listed separately, are the $\mathcal O_E$ and $E$ cases with $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$. Hence its conclusion gives an exact, sum-preserving functor $Rp_*:\Loc(\Dctf(\overline X,\Lambda))\to\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\Lambda))$ carrying $\Dctf(\overline X,\Lambda)$ into $\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$. All coefficients and module-object derived categories are unchanged in this application.

source.place: Second paragraph, Proper direct image; coefficient cases made explicit by det-proper-image-localizing-proper and its own listed hypotheses-hold clauses.

proof.text: *Composite.* Apply the restriction of $j_!$ from step 1 and then that of $Rp_*$ from step 2; the intermediate category is $\Loc(\Dctf(\overline X,\Lambda))$ in both steps. A distinguished triangle first maps to a distinguished triangle under $j_!$, and then under $Rp_*$, with the composite shift isomorphism, so the composite is exact. For any small family $(K_s)$ in the source localizing category the comparison isomorphisms of those two steps give $Rp_*j_!(\bigoplus_s K_s)\simeq Rp_*(\bigoplus_s j_!K_s)\simeq\bigoplus_s Rp_*j_!K_s$. Finally $K\in\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$ implies $j_!K\in\Dctf(\overline X,\Lambda)$ by step 1, hence $Rp_*j_!K\in\Dctf(Y,\Lambda)$ by step 2. These prove all clauses for the specified compactification.

source.place: Third paragraph, Composite, with the triangle and coproduct arguments written out.

proof_origin.place: Three paragraphs: Extension by zero; Proper direct image; Composite.
